title: Tradesman
summary: TRA'DESMAN, noun [trade and man.] A shopkeeper. A merchant is called a trader, but not a tradesman [In America, a shopkeeper is usually called a retailer.]

inlines.v: TRA'DESMAN, noun [trade and man.] A shopkeeper. A merchant is called a trader, but not a tradesman [In America, a shopkeeper is usually called a retailer.]
